core_removal: the complete compatible hypothesis/model fiber and exact response table are no longer supplied to the policy

state_object.name: open belief state
state_object.din_reentry: after each response, the belief state itself is revised and becomes the state from which both hypothesis generation and the next intervention are produced

lanes.HIDDEN_FINITE_SUPPORT: truth belongs to a bounded grammar but the compatible fiber is not enumerated for the policy
lanes.NOVEL_HYPOTHESIS_BIRTH: truth is absent from initial support and must be generated during the sequence
lanes.GRAMMAR_MISSPECIFICATION: truth is outside the allowed birth grammar; correct outcome is model mismatch/abstention
lanes.GAUGE_NULL: multiple hypotheses remain observationally equivalent under every admissible intervention

primary_endpoints: hypothesis birth efficiency per verifier call
policy regret against exhaustive enumerated-fiber ceiling
hard_gates: truth never injected into initial support in novelty lane
oracle ceiling excluded from support evidence
model-mismatch lane must allow explicit abstention
no silent hypothesis resurrection after deauthorization
